text: Binary per-row flag (1/0) on the OP's own argument text only (not title, comments or conversation): 1 if it contains at least one specific counter-question marker, an explicit or interrogative question the OP poses to counter, challenge or probe an opposing position, or to ask readers for a counter-argument, counterexample or rebuttal on a particular point (e.g. "what about X?", "how would you explain Y?", "can anyone show a case where...?"). Purely rhetorical scene-setting questions with no challenge/probe/counter-invitation, and questions inside external quotations or others' reported text not adopted by the OP, don't count. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (including edits like "EDIT: my view was changed"); these never count, but generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Marked edits otherwise count. Output 0 for an assessable argument with no marker; null if argument is missing or malformed.
